# understands

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:understands`](gmeow-understands.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/understands>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/cognition`](../../slices/cognition.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Third level of the knowledge spectrum: the agent comprehends the subject and can reason with and apply it, beyond reciting facts. Entails [`gmeow:knowsAbout`](gmeow-knowsAbout.md) (and transitively [`gmeow:isAwareOf`](gmeow-isAwareOf.md)); entailed by [`gmeow:hasMastered`](gmeow-hasMastered.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) -> [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:knowsAbout`](gmeow-knowsAbout.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:understands`](gmeow-understands.md) from [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) to [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when the agent comprehends a subject and can reason with and apply it, beyond merely reciting facts about it.

### Avoid when

- Avoid when only descriptive familiarity holds (use [`gmeow:knowsAbout`](gmeow-knowsAbout.md)), when expert command holds (use [`gmeow:hasMastered`](gmeow-hasMastered.md)), and avoid reading comprehension as competency — [`gmeow:hasSkill`](gmeow-hasSkill.md) is the orthogonal 'can do' axis.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:understands`](gmeow-understands.md) from the agent to the subject; it entails the two shallower levels and is entailed by [`gmeow:hasMastered`](gmeow-hasMastered.md), so a single assertion materialises the whole tail.

### Examples

- ex:lillith [`gmeow:understands`](gmeow-understands.md) ex:descriptionLogic.
